assertion_audit.failure_condition: Restoring the pre-composition writer, deleting any appended column, or reordering either the scheduler prefix or test suffix makes the produced header differ from the independently written full literal expectation. The expected header is not passed to the writer.

assertion_independence: The only authored assertion change compares a produced header with an independent literal contract; it does not compare output to the same input variable. Imported primary assertions and previously reviewed assertions were not rescored.
durability_limits: The recorded 28-field acceptance, 29-field refusal and 25/28-column compatibility controls could fail and did exercise production code, but no committed regression test for those specific composition controls was added by these two commits.

findings.text: blocking: Appending the test fields makes the source column cease to be last, but tests/test_a_sampler_outlives_the_fleet_job.py:198 still puts node in row[-1], so its assertion at line 215 reads source as '-' and fails; the matched importer logs show this added failure, which must be repaired before the no-added-importer-failures condition holds.

blocking: Setting FLEET_STATE_DIR in the parent fixture leaves tests/test_an_admission_pass_fills_free_slots.py's child service explicitly pointed at a different fleet-state directory; its parent CLI reload request therefore uses a different store and the recorded head arm times out at line 258 waiting for stopped.json, adding the second importer failure.
